name: Ga Nha Trang
kicker: The station front in the centre
summary: Ga Nha Trang is the station Vietnam Tourism places in the centre. The timetable puts it at km 1315 from Hà Nội and km 411 from Sài Gòn. A street address and a ticket price were not printed on the pages used here. Southbound from Hà Nội the five trains take 24 hours 57 minutes to 28 hours 3 minutes.
getThere: In the centre. The street was not printed.
heroCaption: The station front, with the Ga Nha Trang letters over the doors
body: Vietnam Tourism says the train station is in the centre and names it as a way into the city, with the airport to the south. The street of the station was not printed. The national railway timetable, opened 22 October 2026, puts Nha Trang at km 1315 from Hà Nội and km 411 from Sài Gòn. Southbound columns are SE7, SE5, SE9, SE3, and SE1. Northbound train codes were not in the rows used.

Southbound from Hà Nội is 24 hours 57 minutes to 28 hours 3 minutes. Southbound from Đà Nẵng is 9 hours 13 minutes to 11 hours. Northbound to Đà Nẵng is 9 hours 30 minutes to 11 hours 1 minute. Southbound to Sài Gòn is 7 hours 48 minutes to 10 hours 23 minutes. Northbound from Sài Gòn is 7 hours 16 minutes to 8 hours 43 minutes. A fare was not printed on those rows. Check the ticket on arrival.
